dependencies.required_evidence: Arm A must reproduce the frozen HARM-Delta generic causal edit transducer, latest exact-route donor, Q16 endpoint, Q63 parent mixture, sleeping rule, and post-truth update order exactly.

HORIZON continues unchanged. No PALIMPSEST corpus replay may read its scientific outputs or launch until its terminal route publishes admissible immutable Endpoint428 pretruth probabilities, truths, and physical-history source evidence.

A repeated restricted callback stream must expose exact route, normalized route shape, and only content type inferred from already decoded bytes; current truth, future field length, raw_after, offline descriptors, and transmitted identifiers remain forbidden.

The v2 name distinguishes this market experiment from the historical PALIMPSEST factorization and carries forward the requirement to charge parser, realization, source, framing, and package material rather than treating structure as free.

contract.name: PALIMPSEST-MARKET-v2
contract.decision: Freeze one nested retained-parent experiment. Every arm extension changes exactly one axis, and the simplest economically surviving arm wins; only an exact T pass may authorize native implementation.

arms.P: Immutable Endpoint428 probabilities and finite arithmetic payload.
arms.K: All route parsing, reservoirs, market lookup, kernel execution, and posterior updates execute while P alone reaches an independently terminated finite coder.
arms.A: Latest fully completed exact-route ancestor under the frozen HARM-Delta generic causal edit transducer.
arms.M: A fixed newest-first reservoir of at most eight exact-route ancestors, all under the same generic transducer.
arms.H: M plus at most eight normalized-route-shape ancestors and at most eight ancestors for each causally inferred content type, deduplicated in exact, shape, then type precedence.
arms.T: H plus one deterministically assigned typed kernel per ancestor: numeric affine, delimiter substitution, token alignment, or prefix/suffix grafting.
arms.X: T geometry with donor routes deterministically permuted through a bounded pool within power-of-two age and length buckets; the current route is excluded.
arms.C: T's correct donors and generic leaves with every typed-kernel assignment deterministically changed to a different kernel.
arms.G: T geometry over decoder-reconstructed physical-history donors whose causal age exactly matches and whose content type and length bucket match the corresponding H donor.

one_axis_nesting: M differs from A only by admitting exact-route ancestor ranks one through seven.
H differs from M only by admitting shape and causal content-type equivalence levels.
T differs from H only by adding one typed leaf beside each unchanged generic leaf.
X changes donor route association while preserving T leaf count, level, age, length bucket, kernel law, priors, and coder.
C changes only typed-kernel assignment while retaining T donors, generic leaves, priors, and coder.
G changes only semantic donor selection to equally aged physical history while retaining T geometry and arithmetic.

memory.install_rule: Install a nonempty value only after field exit and every declared delayed byte commit; overflowing values sleep and are never installed.

hierarchical_market.rule: Normalize factorized integer priors by deterministic largest remainder. At each bit, combine only awake leaves; after truth, multiply awake leaves by their truth count and sleeping leaves by the market truth count before exact renormalization. Update transducers only after the complete truth byte.
hierarchical_market.outer_parent_rule: Each arm owns one global sleeping Q63 parent-versus-market Bayesian weight. It rounds half upward, clamps only to Q16 endpoints, and remains bit-identical to P while asleep.
hierarchical_market.coin_betting: Excluded from v2. It may enter only as a separately versioned one-axis successor.

typed_kernels.numeric_affine: For a digit-only signed integer donor, maintain a causal integer posterior over a in {-1,1,2} and b in {-1000,-100,-10,-1,0,1,10,100,1000} where defined, rendered without transmitting a transform.
typed_kernels.delimiter_substitution: At the current donor position, strongly preserve frozen ASCII delimiters while assigning positive class mass to substituted alphanumeric bytes.
typed_kernels.token_alignment: Track current decoded alphanumeric token ordinal and within-token offset, then mix bounded donor token offsets -2 through +2 before observing the next truth.
typed_kernels.prefix_suffix_grafting: Mix the full donor prefix with suffixes beginning at up to four deterministic token or delimiter boundaries and update their posterior causally.

finite_coder_replay.input: Immutable Endpoint428 Q16 pretruth probabilities, exact WRT truths, repeated causal route callbacks, and repeated matched physical sources.
finite_coder_replay.coder: Independent 32-bit finite binary arithmetic coder for P/K/A/M/H/T/X/C/G with explicit bit-count frame, E1/E2/E3 renormalization, termination, byte padding, and decoder replay.
finite_coder_replay.decision_unit: Literal terminated payload bytes, including the identical explicit frame. Ideal bits and block bootstrap summaries are diagnostic only.
finite_coder_replay.accounting: Charge actual payload, framing, models, tables, source, and other transmitted package material to score. Keep process-tree memory and runtime as separate hard gates; never convert them into byte costs.
finite_coder_replay.parent_rule: P and K must match at every probability, coder interval transition, terminated payload byte, and final payload hash.

frozen_populations.state_warm_rule: Replay from canonical raw byte zero through each scope end and measure only routes whose pretruth raw coordinate lies in the frozen half-open scope.
frozen_populations.chronological_thirds: Use canonical raw pretruth coordinates with third=min(2,floor(3*(raw_before-raw_begin)/(raw_end-raw_begin))).
frozen_populations.promotion_authority: The block bootstrap may describe stability or rank diagnostics but has no promotion or rescue authority.

economic_gates.control_rule: On both scopes T's terminated payload must be smaller than A, M, H, X, C, and G after applying T's prospectively frozen incremental package ceiling relative to each comparator.
economic_gates.survival_rule: If M, H, or T misses its own marginal economic or hard resource gate, stop at the simplest preceding arm that passes; do not rescue a failed extension by the performance of a later arm.

resource_gates.rule: Report measured wall, user, and system execution separately. A runtime or memory miss blocks promotion but does not alter payload bytes. Native integration requires a fresh composite resource receipt.

midas_boundary.overlap_rule: Use expert competition if overlap dominates. If both mechanisms retain residual value, expose only decoder-visible posterior entropy, selected transformation family, and parent-surprise gap to MIDAS.
midas_boundary.joint_rule: Any combination requires a fresh joint finite archive and may never add gains across changed probability trajectories or state.

contract.native_authorization: Only a valid repeated exact finite-coder replay in which T passes P/K identity, HARM-A identity, M>A, H>M, T>H, T>A/M/H/X/C/G economics, every chronological third, distant transfer, package accounting, causality, runtime, and memory gates may authorize one new native candidate. No native source is authorized by this freeze alone.

activation_requirements: The active HORIZON experiment has terminalized through its fail-closed terminal router without modifying or reading live scientific output early.
Immutable repeated Endpoint428 pretruth probability and truth streams exist for both frozen populations.
The restricted route callback carries a prospectively frozen normalized route-shape identifier and proves current content type is inferred only from decoded prefix bytes.
Repeated physical candidates bind exact target, source, age, length bucket, context witness, and decoder-reconstructible continuation.
The complete shadow source tree, finite coder, output manifest, hard resource guard, and decision receipt schema are content-addressed before replay.
claim_boundary: This artifact, all source-only fixtures, and every future shadow receipt grant zero archive and objective score credit.
No HORIZON result, PALIMPSEST shadow result, or MIDAS result is additive across a changed probability path.
No block bootstrap, ideal-log-loss estimate, correct-byte count, parser-free estimate, or runtime-to-byte conversion can promote an arm.
The final objective remains one complete counted, exact, eligible 105000000-byte-or-smaller artifact over canonical enwik9.
